verdict.rationale: Loops documents event-triggered lifecycle workflows for onboarding, trial, re-engagement and winback, with workflow graphs whose nodes can be branched (shown via the API). The evidence never mentions time delays or exit/goal rules, which are explicit parts of the story. missing for 10: documented delay/wait steps, exit or goal rules, first-party docs on the visual workflow builder for marketers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: Set up onboarding, activation, upgrade, and winback emails once, then improve them over time.
Build onboarding, trial, and re-engagement workflows around your product events.
Create and update workflow graphs, change mailing lists, and add, branch, edit, or delete nodes from code.
POST /events/send Send an event to trigger workflows
